text: {"lessons":["My account value rose overall, but five periods are too little evidence to know whether my trades helped; I should judge decisions over time, not by a few gains or losses.","Selling Stock A below my average cost and later buying more reminds me to base trades on my current view and risk limits, not just on my purchase price or the urge to recover a loss.","Before buying more stocks or taking profits, I should keep enough cash and consider how each trade fits my ten-year apartment goal; frequent trades alone do not guarantee faster growth."]}
